properties.name: British Columbia (Canadian Pacific) Exclusive Economic Zone
properties.source: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions, maritime boundaries v12
properties.note: The Pacific component of Canada's EEZ only, extracted from the national MultiPolygon (everything west of 120W and reaching south of 60N). Interior rings (islands) are dropped: the mask is intersected with `sst_daily`, which holds ocean cells only, so land inside the zone is excluded by the data rather than by the geometry -- and a clean outline is what the map wants. Douglas-Peucker simplified at 0.002 deg, which is 1/25 of a grid cell: measured, it moves 21 of 26,155 cells against the unsimplified ring. Longitudes are 0-360, as everywhere else in this project.
